basis: Hematopoietic/immune-cell deficiency; hearing loss and respiratory failure each annotated 80-99%; ocular damage and lymphatic dysfunction omitted by cap.
Retinal rod-cone degeneration and congenital sensorineural hearing loss define this Usher subtype.
Deep dermal/subcutaneous and mucosal edema; umbrella includes immune and nonimmune mechanisms. Variable oral/laryngeal attacks do not establish additional lasting organ damage.
Mesenchymal soft-tissue tumor, typically arising in extremity connective tissues; metastases are rare.
Skeletal myopathy with muscle-fiber abnormalities, weakness and contractures; ophthalmoplegia occurs in 2/11 and respiratory insufficiency in 5-29%.
Malignant neoplasm of blood-vessel origin; no additional anatomical site is specified.
Clear-cell cystadenofibroma is an ovarian epithelial-stromal neoplasm; reproductive organs have no axis.
Inherited retinal cone/cone-rod degeneration with impaired vision.
Upper-limb skeletal malformations and congenital cardiac structural/conduction abnormalities define Holt-Oram syndrome.
Polyp arises in the frontal sinus; paranasal sinuses belong to the pulmonary axis.
Blepharophimosis, lacrimal abnormalities and thickened facial skin define the syndrome; unusual nasal shape alone does not establish airway damage.
Schizophrenia is a purely psychiatric disorder under these axis rules.
Nonbacterial erosion damages dental pulp; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Cystic lymphatic-vessel malformation/neoplasm; vessel origin determines the axis, rather than its usual neck location.
Frontotemporal cortical and motor-neuron degeneration define the disease; muscle wasting reflects denervation rather than intrinsic muscle disease.
Congenital uterine duplication affects reproductive anatomy, which has no axis.
Malignancy originates in cutaneous apocrine sweat glands.
Necrotizing lesion of minor salivary glands; salivary glands and oral mucosa belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Severe bone fragility defines type III; dentinogenesis imperfecta directly damages teeth in roughly half or more. Scleral color is non-damaging; hearing involvement is variable.
LINS1-related intellectual disability, developmental delay and microcephaly define a neurodevelopmental disorder.
Astrocytic tumor originates in the brainstem.
Hemangiopericytoma/SFT is a mesenchymal soft-tissue tumor. Mediastinal location alone does not establish lung or cardiovascular involvement.
Adenocarcinoma originates in the prostate, a reproductive organ; urinary tract invasion or obstruction is not intrinsic to the concept.
Benign neoplasm originates in the fallopian tube, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Inherited reductase deficiency impairs erythrocyte hemoglobin reduction. Neurologic damage belongs to minority generalized type II, not most patients across types I and II.
